title: Aldo Stark's James Bond-inspired Delray Beach estate goes under contract at $85M
summary: Developer Aldo Stark found a buyer for Villa Skyfall, a 22,440-SF, nine-bedroom estate at 16121 Quiet Vista Circle in Stone Creek Ranch, at an $85M asking price, or $3,790 per SF, likely a neighborhood record. A Stark affiliate paid $5.9M in 2024. It was one of 17 Palm Beach County contracts above $3M signed Oct. 25 to Nov. 1, totaling $202.7M in asking volume, the highest weekly total of the quarter.

title: Nuveen sells 286-unit Coconut Creek apartments to Legacy Residential for $52.6M
summary: Nuveen sold the 286-unit, 242,180-SF apartment complex at 4854 Fishermans Drive in the Landings at Coconut Creek to Legacy Residential Group for $52.6M, or $183,900 per unit. It last traded in July 2017 for $45.3M. Legacy secured a $35.5M acquisition loan from TD Bank. The deal topped TRD's Nov. 2 South Florida transaction digest, which also listed BKM Capital's $33M purchase of a Pompano Beach industrial park.

title: BTI, Bridge Investment land $109.2M Freddie Mac refi on 362-unit Hollywood Bread Building
summary: BTI Partners and Bridge Investment Group obtained a $109.2M Freddie Mac refinancing from Greystone for the 25-story, 362-unit Hollywood Bread Building at 1770 South Young Circle, arranged by Cushman & Wakefield. The loan carries a 35-year amortization with interest-only payments for the full term. The building is fully leased, with monthly rents of $2,171 to $4,565. BTI paid $11M for the site in 2021.

title: Alta Developers lands $140.2M JVP construction loan for 400-unit Alta New River in Fort Lauderdale
summary: Alta Developers secured a $140.2M senior construction loan from JVP Management for Alta New River, a 35-story, 400-apartment project at 100 SW Sixth Street in Fort Lauderdale. The debt works out to $350,500 per planned unit and replaces a 2023 loan. Alta paid $20.8M for the 1-acre site in 2022. Construction is expected to start this month, with Greystar managing and completion expected in Q4 2028.

title: Ytech unveils 52-story, 106-unit 75 Broadway condo tower in Brickell, from $3M
summary: Miami-based Ytech revealed 75 Broadway, a 680-foot, 52-story luxury condo tower facing Biscayne Bay and Simpson Park, with 106 units including seven penthouses. Condos start at $3M with no more than three units per floor, though zoning allows nearly 300 units. KPF is the architect, Cervera Real Estate is the sales firm, and completion is expected in late 2029. It is Ytech's second Brickell condo project, alongside the 70-story 1428 Brickell.

title: RK Centers pays $32.5M for Edens' Total Wine-anchored Arena Shops in North Miami
summary: RK Centers, led by Raanan Katz, bought the 44,660-SF Arena Shops at 14750 Biscayne Blvd in North Miami from Edens for $32.5M, or $728 per SF. Edens paid $25M in 2012. The 1993-built center on 2.5 acres is anchored by Total Wine & More. Colliers puts Q3 Northeast Miami-Dade asking rent at $27.65 per SF with 3.8% vacancy.

title: Miami Beach rejects Blackstone's 38-story Live Local Act plan for Southgate Towers
summary: Miami Beach's planning director ruled that Blackstone-owned Southgate Towers LLC's Live Local Act application at 910 West Avenue is ineligible because the site is residentially zoned. The proposal would replace two 14-story buildings with 442 units (264 condos, 178 workforce apartments). Air Communities paid $250.5M for the property in 2023. The ruling is not final and can be appealed to the board of adjustment.

title: Terra, Fortune land $220M Blackstone pre-development loan for Key Biscayne condos
summary: Terra and Fortune International Group obtained $220M in pre-development financing from Blackstone Real Estate Debt Strategies for a 14-story, 56-unit ultra-luxury condo at 301 Ocean Drive, the former Silver Sands Beach Resort site in Key Biscayne. Walker & Dunlop arranged the debt. The developers paid a record $205M for the 4.25-acre site last year, and pre-construction sales are expected to launch this year.

title: Gencom, White Bridge buy 652-room InterContinental Miami, reportedly for $300M
summary: Gencom and White Bridge Capital bought the 34-story, 652-room InterContinental at 100 Chopin Plaza in downtown Miami from Dajia Insurance Group's Strategic Hotels & Resorts. Bloomberg, citing an anonymous source, reported $300M, or about $460,123 per key, 9% above the $422,000 Florida full-service average per MSCI Real Capital Analytics. The buyers confirmed the sale but not the price. It is their third joint hotel deal in a year.

title: Bomar Builders' 15K-SF Las Olas spec megamansion lists for $100M, Broward's priciest
summary: A proposed 15,185-SF estate at 708 Royal Plaza Drive in Fort Lauderdale hit the market at $100M, the most expensive listing in Broward County per Zillow, or $6,585 per SF if built as designed. The 0.92-acre lot has 548 feet of water frontage. Heather Lefka of Florida Luxurious Properties holds the listing; the land may be sold separately. It tops an $80M Riviera Isle proposal listed in July.

title: Charles Cohen lands $385M in construction debt for West Palm Point office tower
summary: Cohen Brothers Realty secured $385M ($350M plus $35M) for West Palm Point, a 23-story, 438,000-SF, $400M office building at 850 S. Quadrille Blvd in downtown West Palm Beach. Cooper Horowitz's Robert Horowitz arranged the debt; lenders were not disclosed. Construction has started, with completion expected in Q1 2029 after the city extended the deadline to January 2029.

title: Industrial equipment exec pays $71M off-market for Naples Gordon Drive estate
summary: Douglas Schumann of P-Q Controls paid $69.4M for the 9,550-SF property at 2050 Gordon Drive plus $1.6M for furnishings, about $7,435 per SF. The seller was a trust tied to Culligan International's Scott Gibbs Clawson. The sale came about $4M under the $75M private ask, and the site last traded for $30M in 2022. Compass says it is its highest-priced Florida deal this year.

title: Faena Residences Miami closes $817M Tyko loan, Florida's largest condo construction loan
summary: Fortune International Group and KAR Properties closed an $817M construction loan from Tyko Capital for the 440-unit, two-tower Faena Residences Miami at 24 SW Fourth Street on the Miami River. Walker & Dunlop arranged the financing, which the developers say is the largest condo construction loan in Florida history. Completion is expected in early 2030, with more than $500M in presales reported.

title: Driftwood, Merrimac, MV score $145M Centennial Bank loan for Miami Riverside Wharf
summary: The developers of the $350M Riverside Wharf at 114 SW North River Drive secured $145M in construction financing from Centennial Bank. The 200,000 SF, nine-story, two-tower project will include a 167-room Dream Hotel, a 30,000 SF nightclub, a 12,000 SF event hall and 16,000 SF of restaurant space. Completion is targeted for fall 2028.

title: Glaser, Edelstein under contract at $160M for Palm Beach teardown estate
summary: Developers Todd Glaser and TriCap's David Edelstein are under contract to pay $160M for 911 North Ocean Boulevard, per the Wall Street Journal. That is just under the island's $170M record set in 2023. The 2.2-acre site has 250 feet of ocean frontage and about 17,600 SF of 1970s buildings, or roughly $9,100 per SF. The family listed it at $185M last year; the buyers plan to split it into two lots.

title: Fortune, Château land $463M Madison Realty loan for St. Regis Sunny Isles
summary: Madison Realty Capital is providing a $463M loan package for the two-tower St. Regis Residences at 18801 Collins Avenue, one of the largest loans to close in Sunny Isles Beach. It refinances existing debt, including Bank OZK loans from 2020. The project is 80% presold; the south tower (150 units) is under vertical construction and the north tower (170 units) is next. Remaining units start at $5.1M.
